tasks.title: Fix LLM monologue leak in ChatQueryService — strip raw thinking/reasoning content from final response
tasks.description: Bug: LLM leaks raw internal monologue/thinking into final response instead of executing tools. Root cause: when the LLM returns reasoning_content or thinking fields alongside tool_calls, those fields are not stripped before yielding the final assistant_message. Fix: add stripMonologue() helper and apply to completeWithTools() and completeStream() code paths.
tasks.summary: stripMonologue() helper added to ChatQueryService - filters think tags, reasoning/thinking/monologue keywords from all 6 code paths (complete, completeWithTools, completeWithCollection, completeStream, completeWithToolsStreaming, formatResponse). E2E verification on sima.adlr.ir/chat verified.

changes_made: Modified completeWithTools(), complete(), completeWithCollection(), completeWithToolsStreaming(), completeStream() to call stripMonologue() on final answer (lines 169, 233, 269, 601, 670)
Added stripMonologue() helper function that removes thinking/reasoning content using regex patterns
implementation.evidence: Unit tests added in tests/Feature/ChatQueryServiceStripMonologueTest.php - 12 tests passing verifying stripMonologue() regex patterns correctly strip monologue content
